$comment: Negative Space motion data: slow, few moves, long holds. Springs are critically damped or close to it (damping ratio = c / (2 * sqrt(k * m)) of about 1.0), so nothing overshoots; the build simulates them into CSS linear() easings. Timings are rules of thumb of this style, not measured findings. Video rules live in art.json -> media.video.
character: Stillness with one slow event. The piece opens on empty ground, one thing arrives or drifts, the words settle, and then everything holds. Motion should feel like a breath or a tide, never like a notification.

springs.$comment: stiffness k, damping c, mass m. All at or just above critical damping: no overshoot.

settle.use: Default: the object and the text block arriving (ratio about 1.02, settles in about 1.2 s).

still.use: Large or slow arrivals: the object easing in from far away, a hero image settling (ratio about 1.03, settles in about 1.6 s).

soft.use: Interactive UI: hover, open, toggle. No overshoot.

drift.use: Slow travel and loops: a boat crossing, a kite rising, a cloud passing. Sine-like, no visible start or stop.

fade.use: Text and small marks fading in: quick start, long gentle finish.

rise.use: Text block appearing: a very short rise with a fade. Half the distance of other styles.

pop.use: The object appearing (scale from 0 is allowed only for small objects under 12% of the short side; larger ones fade).

draw.use: A horizon hairline drawing across from the reading-start side.

drift.use: The object travelling slowly into the open field (a boat, a bird, a figure), 3-10% of the artboard width over 8-20 s.

breathe.use: A resting object staying barely alive. Optional.

float.use: A floating object bobbing by 0.5% of the artboard.

fadeIn.use: Brand, CTA and details appearing after the headline.

durations.$comment: Slower than the other styles. Rule of thumb for transforms that are not springs.
durations.formula: duration = 500 ms + 0.6 ms per pixel travelled (capped at 1600 ms); loops and drifts are exempt

order: brand, details and CTA (fade in together)
choreography.openOnGround: Every sequence starts on the empty ground for 600-1000 ms: the space is introduced before anything is put in it.
choreography.settleBeforeText: Text starts only after the object has settled.

loop.endsOn: The finished composition, held for at least 2 s before the loop restarts. Most pieces should not loop at all.

rules: At most three moves per piece, one at a time, then a long hold.
Open on empty ground; end on the finished still frame and hold it.
Nothing overshoots, bounces, spins, shakes or flashes.
Text never moves after it has arrived, and never moves with the object.
Drifts go into the open field, in the direction the object faces.
No parallax, camera moves or zooms in graphic pieces; video follows art.json -> media.video.
With reduced motion: show the final frame; drifts, floats and breathes stop.
